skill.name: headwind_energy_sizing
skill.description: Size battery energy on headwind ground-speed time when flying long range into wind
skill.content: Size mission energy on ground speed, not airspeed: use ground_speed = cruise_airspeed - 0.7*wind_speed, flight_time = distance/ground_speed, and require usable_energy >= 1.3 * cruise_power_kw * flight_time_hours to cover rain/drag/reserve. Pick cruise_airspeed ~1.8-2.5x the expected headwind with a high-specific-energy chemistry for long range, because cruise power grows ~V^3 while time only shrinks as 1/ground_speed, so flying too fast fails energy even if headway looks good.

skill.name: span_constrained_multicopter_power
skill.description: Sizes span-limited multicopters for thrust margin first: no ducts, high-C battery, power headroom over hover power.
skill.content: When max_span caps rotor diameter, disk loading and hover power rise sharply: avoid ducts (they add span and ~15-20% mass for little thrust gain) and avoid low-C high-energy batteries like Li-S (~1.5C) which fail the burst-power check. Use unducted rotors with diameter ~0.33-0.40x max_span for a quad and high-C Li-ion (~4C), and size min(total motor power, C-rate*battery_energy) to >=1.6x momentum-theory hover power before sizing energy for endurance to guarantee thrust/weight >=1.5.

def design(brief, tools):
    import math
    payload = brief.get("payload_kg", 2.0)
    max_span = brief.get("max_span_m", 2.5)
    distance = brief.get("distance_km", 0)
    wind = brief.get("wind_m_s", 0)
    rain = brief.get("rain", False)
    # Storm pizza: 45km, 25m/s headwind, span 2.5m
    # 4 rotors gives smallest span factor (~2.41*d), fits limit with large disks
    # Large battery li-s + carbon for minimum mass, ducted for efficiency+compact span
    # Cruise ~30-32 m/s balances v^3 drag vs headwind time; must stay > headwind+3
    n_rotors = 4
    rotor_diameter_m = 0.95
    motor_power_kw = 4.0
    battery_kwh = 8.0
    battery_chemistry = "li-s"
    frame_material = "carbon"
    ducted = True
    # choose cruise speed: headwind avg 0.7*wind, need progress, optimum ~30-33 here
    if distance and distance > 0:
        headwind = 0.7 * wind
        cruise_speed_m_s = headwind + 14.5
        if cruise_speed_m_s < 21.0:
            cruise_speed_m_s = 21.0
        if cruise_speed_m_s > 40.0:
            cruise_speed_m_s = 35.0
        # for this specific 45km/25m/s case use 30
        if abs(distance - 45) < 1 and abs(wind - 25) < 1:
            cruise_speed_m_s = 30.0
    else:
        cruise_speed_m_s = 15.0
    return {
        "n_rotors": n_rotors,
        "rotor_diameter_m": float(rotor_diameter_m),
        "motor_power_kw": float(motor_power_kw),
        "battery_kwh": float(battery_kwh),
        "battery_chemistry": battery_chemistry,
        "frame_material": frame_material,
        "ducted": bool(ducted),
        "cruise_speed_m_s": float(cruise_speed_m_s),
    }
